messages.text: Is there a non political globe?

The 12" Mercury Planetary Globe you're looking at is actually a great fit for that — it's part of our Astronomy Magazine series, showing Mercury's actual surface rather than Earth's countries and borders, so there's no political map on it at all. It's a nice pick for anyone into space or science over geography. Want me to tell you a bit more about it, or are you also curious about other planets in that same series (like Jupiter, Venus, or the Moon)?

Sure — the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe is our flagship Earth globe. By day it shows a detailed political map with countries and cap····, and when you switch on the light it reveals the physical terrain underneath — mountain ranges, ocean depths, all in relief you can feel with your fingertips. It's a true centrepiece, hand-assembled in the USA on a handcrafted hardwood stand. If you'd rather keep it on the desk since you were just browsing Mercury, the National Geographic Adams 12-inch Illuminated Antique Desktop Globe gives you that same day/night terrain reveal in a smaller size.

viewed: 12" Mercury Planetary Globe - Astronomy Magazine Edition
